claims: The Cleveland Cavaliers defeated the Toronto Raptors 126-113 on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
The game was the Cleveland Cavaliers' playoff opener.
The Cleveland Cavaliers took a 1-0 series lead.
Donovan Mitchell led the Cleveland Cavaliers with 32 points.
Game 2 is Monday, April 20, 2026, at 7:00 PM EDT according to the NBA schedule.
Game 2 location is Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse, Cleveland.
Game 2 TV channels are Peacock, NBC Sports Network.
The Cleveland Cavaliers lead the series 1-0.
